title: Cissy’s quick motherwit guessed what was amiss and she whispered to Edy Boardman to take him there behind the pushcar where the gentleman couldn’t see and to mind he didn’t wet his new tan shoes.
html_source: Typical of the hoity-toity way in which Cissy and the group considers the world, referring to urination quietly and sensitively, ensuring that Tommy is not embarrassed and that his new shoes are preserved, urine-free.
